description: Source code implementing an AWS Nova Sonic speech-to-speech LLM service for Pipecat AI, including classes, methods, and event handling for bidirectional audio streaming, context management, and response processing.

classes.name: ContentType
classes.description: Enum representing supported content types: AUDIO, TEXT, TOOL.

classes.name: TextStage
classes.description: Enum representing stages of text generation: FINAL, SPECULATIVE.

classes.name: CurrentContent
classes.description: Data class representing current content being received from AWS Nova Sonic, including type, role, text stage, and content.

classes.name: Params
classes.description: Configuration parameters for AWS Nova Sonic, including audio, inference, and turn-taking settings.

classes.name: AWSNovaSonicLLMService
classes.description: Main class implementing the speech-to-speech LLM service using AWS Nova Sonic, handling connection lifecycle, event processing, context management, and response reporting.

classes.name: AWSNovaSonicUnhandledFunctionException
classes.description: Exception raised when the LLM attempts to call an unregistered function.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the service and initiates connection to AWS Nova Sonic.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the service and disconnects.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the service and disconnects.

methods.name: reset_conversation
methods.description: Resets conversation state while preserving context, disconnects, and reconnects.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames and handles service-specific logic based on frame type.

methods.name: _handle_context
methods.description: Handles updates to the conversation context.

methods.name: _handle_input_audio_frame
methods.description: Handles incoming raw audio frames from user.

methods.name: _handle_bot_stopped_speaking
methods.description: Handles the event when the bot stops speaking, finalizing responses.

methods.name: _handle_interruption_frame
methods.description: Handles interruption frames, possibly marking assistant response for re-push.

methods.name: _start_connecting
methods.description: Establishes connection, creates client, starts stream, and sets up context.

methods.name: _process_completed_function_calls
methods.description: Checks for completed function calls in context and sends results.

methods.name: _finish_connecting_if_context_available
methods.description: Completes connection setup once context and readiness are confirmed.

methods.name: _disconnect
methods.description: Closes connection, cleans up resources, and resets state.

methods.name: _create_client
methods.description: Creates and returns a BedrockRuntimeClient configured for AWS.

methods.name: _is_first_generation_sonic_model
methods.description: Checks if the model is the older 'nova-sonic-v1:0'.

methods.name: _is_endpointing_sensitivity_supported
methods.description: Determines if endpointing_sensitivity is supported (only with Nova 2 Sonic).

methods.name: _is_assistant_response_trigger_needed
methods.description: Checks if assistant response trigger audio is needed (only with older model).

methods.name: _send_session_start_event
methods.description: Sends session start event with inference configuration.

methods.name: _send_prompt_start_event
methods.description: Sends prompt start event with tools and output configuration.

methods.name: _send_audio_input_start_event
methods.description: Sends event to start audio input content.

methods.name: _send_text_event
methods.description: Sends text input event with role and content.

methods.name: _send_user_audio_event
methods.description: Sends user audio bytes as event.

methods.name: _send_session_end_events
methods.description: Sends session end and prompt end events.

methods.name: _send_tool_result
methods.description: Sends result of a tool call.

methods.name: _send_client_event
methods.description: Sends a generic event JSON to the stream.

methods.name: _receive_task_handler
methods.description: Handles incoming responses from the stream, processing events.

methods.name: _handle_completion_start_event
methods.description: Placeholder for handling start of completion event.

methods.name: _handle_content_start_event
methods.description: Handles start of content, sets current content, and triggers response start if assistant.

methods.name: _handle_text_output_event
methods.description: Handles text output content, appending to current content.

methods.name: _handle_audio_output_event
methods.description: Handles audio output content, decodes and pushes audio frame.

methods.name: _handle_tool_use_event
methods.description: Handles tool use event, calls registered function, or raises exception.

methods.name: _handle_content_end_event
methods.description: Handles end of content, updates context, and reports response or user transcription.

methods.name: _handle_completion_end_event
methods.description: Placeholder for handling end of completion event.

methods.name: _report_assistant_response_started
methods.description: Reports start of assistant response and TTS start frame.

methods.name: _report_assistant_response_text_added
methods.description: Reports assistant response text, buffers for potential re-push.

methods.name: _report_assistant_response_ended
methods.description: Reports end of assistant response, handles re-push if needed, clears buffer.

methods.name: _report_user_transcription_text_added
methods.description: Reports user transcription text, buffers chunks.

methods.name: _report_user_transcription_ended
methods.description: Reports end of user transcription, wraps with start/stop frames if trigger.

methods.name: create_context_aggregator
methods.description: Creates context aggregator pair for managing conversation context (deprecated).

methods.name: trigger_assistant_response
methods.description: Sends trigger audio to prompt assistant to start speaking.

methods.name: _send_assistant_response_trigger
methods.description: Sends pre-recorded trigger audio in chunks, with optional blank lead.
